scope: T4 follow-up step 3 (default-path elimination): the default heuristic path no longer explores the schedule catalog, derives non-reference payloads, or builds stream candidates

structural_theorem.claim: Static catalog ranking is a constant function, so the default path provably installs the reference schedule.
premises: logical traffic upper bounds are schedule-independent: input-storage read instance counts x root bytes plus statement-domain instance counts x per-call profile facts; the derivation (aer.rs derive_region_tensor_memory logical terms) never reads the schedule map
catalog candidates share the source imports and carry no rewrite evidence, so rewrite flops are structurally zero on every catalog
structural_theorem.consequence: any source-first static cost over these facts ties across candidates and selects the reference; the T3 ranking functions (heuristic_candidate_cost, heuristic_default_proposal) and the tuning_flop_byte_ratio constant are retired instead of kept as dead generality
structural_theorem.test_pin: test_recirculation asserts every measured-mode catalog proposal's logical (read, write) bytes equal the reference's

changes.contracts/region_selection.py: RegionSelectionPolicy gains tuning: Literal[heuristic, measured] = heuristic (rides the signed timeline so worker-side re-derivation matches the driver); heuristic_candidate_cost deleted
changes.authoring.py: specialize passes options.tuning into the region policy
changes.execution/tokenwise_region.py: compile_tokenwise_region explores the catalog, derives serial payloads and stream plans only when policy.tuning == measured; heuristic keeps compile_tokenwise_source's reference-only region; heuristic_default_proposal deleted

changes.rust/pllm_core/region_selection.rs: Policy mirror gains tuning (TuningPolicy::Heuristic default) so signed timelines decode
changes.funding: heuristic mode reserves the reference peak only; measured mode keeps the max-across-candidates reservation the measured install path relies on
